def fast_pow(base, exp, mod):
    res = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return res

def main():
    P, K = map(int, input().split())

    MOD = 1000000007

    if K == 0:
        print(fast_pow(P, P - 1, MOD))
        return
    if K == 1:
        print(fast_pow(P, P, MOD))
        return

    visited = [False] * P
    cycleCount = 0
    current = 1
    while not visited[current]:
        visited[current] = True
        cycleCount += 1
        current = (K * current) % P

    print(fast_pow(P, cycleCount, MOD))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
